purpose: Add /artifacts/ to .gitignore so scripts/security/build-asvs-matrix.mjs's local run output (regenerated on every ASVS applicability-decisions verification pass) stops showing as untracked. No script logic or application code changes.
requiredInvariants: Only an addition to .gitignore; no existing ignore rule is removed or narrowed.
/artifacts/ has never been committed in git history (verified: git log --all -- artifacts/ is empty) and is not referenced by any workflow as a path it checks out or expects tracked.
No production, REG.RU, DNS or database mutation.
This scope changes no application code.
acceptance: git status --ignored shows artifacts/ as ignored after running scripts/security/build-asvs-matrix.mjs.
node --test scripts/security/*.test.mjs is unaffected (still whatever it was before this change).
